summary: QNB Corp. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a firm-commitment underwritten offering of 1,071,428 common shares at $42.00 per share, raising about $45.0 million gross ($42.3 million net of 6% underwriting discounts) ahead of its uplisting to the Nasdaq Capital Market under symbol QNBC on August 20, 2026, with OTCQX trading ending that morning. The prior OTCQX close was $43.51, implying a roughly 3.5% discount. Brean Capital and Performance Trust Capital Partners are underwriters; a 160,714-share, 30-day over-allotment option applies. This is an ordinary shelf takedown and listing event, not a special situation; watch capital deployment and pricing pressure from the new float.
